MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  November 12, 2019

NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action taken by
the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the only record of official
City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they are approved by the City Council
at its next regularly scheduled meeting.

CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority, Library
Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

Called to order at 5:02 p.m.

IINVOCATION: Mayor Pro Tem Goodell

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Council Member Sachs

PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Proclaim November 10 through 16, 2019 To Be "National Nurse Practitioner Week"

  Presented proclamation to Nurse Practitioner Mary Beth McGowan.

  P2.  Featured Businesses of the Month - International Termite and McGriff Tile

  Presented proclamations to James McCall and Monty McGriff.

  P3,  South Orange County Vet Center

  Continued to a future meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR

B/K  Approved the Consent Calendar as outlined below.

  1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council Meeting of October 22, 2019, as
  presented.

  2.  Check Register Dated October 11, 2019 in the Amount of $1,070,155.09

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

City Council Agenda  1  November 12, 2019
   3.  Check Register Dated October 18, 2019 in the Amount of $2,640,334.81

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  4.  Check Register Dated October 25, 2019 in the Amount of $913,023.20

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  5.  City Treasurer’s Monthly Report for September 2019

  Received and filed.

  6.  Mission Viejo Community Development Financing Authority (MVCDFA) Treasurer’s
  Monthly Report for September 2019

  Received and filed.

  7.  Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency Treasurer’s Monthly
  Report for September 2019

  Received and filed.

  8.  Mission Viejo Housing Authority (MVHA) Treasurer’s Monthly Report for
  September 2019

  Received and filed.

  9.  Transmittal of Pre-PARE Trust Financial Report for the quarter ending September
  30, 2019

  Received and filed the accompanying Pre-PARE Trust Financial Report for the quarter
  ending September 30, 2019.

  10.  Los Alisos Boulevard and Santa Margarita Parkway Intersection Improvements (CIP
  18238)—Notice of Completion

  (1) Certified the completion of and accept the improvements for the subject project; (2)
  authorized the City Manager to sign the Notice of Completion; (3) authorized the City Clerk
  to record the Notice of Completion with the County of Orange and to release the faithful
  performance and payment bonds one year and 35 days, respectively, after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion contingent upon no claims or liens being filed with
  the City; and (4) authorized the release of the final retention 35 days after the date of
  recordation of the Notice of Completion.

  11.  Orange County Transportation Authority 2019/2020 Comprehensive Transportation
  Funding Program Call-for-Projects

  (1) Adopted Resolution 19-40 Approving the Submittal of the Marguerite Parkway and
  Jeronimo Road Intersection Capacity Enhancement Project Under the Regional Capacity
City Council Agenda  2  November 12, 2019
   Program (Project O) to the Orange County Transportation Authority for Funding Under
  the Comprehensive Transportation Funding Program.

  12.  City Pool Vehicle Lease Agreement

  (1) Authorized the City Manager to enter into a Lease Agreement with Enterprise Fleet
  Management (“EFM”) (A19-55) for the lease of a 2019 Chevrolet Bolt LT; and (2) adopted
  Resolution 19-41 Amending the Fiscal Year 2019/2020 Budget for Costs Related to the
  Lease of an Electric Vehicle for Use as a City Pool Car.

  13.  Via Fabricante Area Catch Basin Debris Screens (CIP 20241)

  Awarded the construction contract in the amount of $124,874.00 to G2 Construction, Inc.,
  (A19-56) for the subject project.

  14.  SB2 Planning Grant Program

  Adopted Resolution 19-42 Authorizing Application for, and Receipt of, SB2 Planning Grant
  Program Funds.

  15.  Business Recruitment Consultant Services

  Authorized the City Manager and City Attorney to execute a 1-year agreement with Retail
  Strategies (A19-57) for an amount not to exceed $50,000.

 ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

  PUBLIC HEARINGS

  16.  Ordinance Adopting the 2019 California Building and Fire Codes, the International
  Swimming Pool and Spa Code and the International Property Maintenance Code

  S/G  (1) Adopted Ordinance 19-332 Adopting by Reference the 2019 Editions of the California
  Building, Residential, Plumbing, Electrical, Mechanical, Green Building Standards,
  Historical Building, and Existing Building Codes, and the 2018 Editions of the International
  Swimming Pool and Spa Code and International Property Maintenance Code, Together, with
  Certain Appendices and Amendments Thereto, and Amending Title 8 of the Mission Viejo
  Municipal Code; (2) ) adopted Resolution 19-43 Setting Forth Findings for Required
  Amendments to the 2019 California Building Code Relative to Local Climatic, Topographic,
  and Geologic Conditions; (3) Adopted Ordinance 19-333 Adopting by Reference the 2019
  California Fire Code, Together with Certain Amendments and Deletions; and (4) adopted
  Resolution 19-44 Setting Forth Findings for Required Amendments to the 2019 California
  Fire Code Relative to Local Climatic, Topographic, and Geologic Conditions.

  17.  Installation of Speed Humps on Modesto Drive

  K/G  Approved the installation of speed humps on Modesto Drive.
  B/S No

   OLD BUSINESS

  18.  Update on Recreation Related Capital Improvement Program Projects

  Received the report.

  MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  19.  Orange County Veterans Advisory Council

  Received report from Chairman of the Orange County Veterans Advisory Council Bobby
  McDonald. .

  20.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Report

  Council Member Sachs deferred his report to Fire Chief Capobianco.

  21.  Southern California Association of Governments (SCAG) Report

  Received report from Council Member Bucknum.

  STAFF REPORTS

  22.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Update from Chief Capobianco

  Received report.

  23.  Orange County Sheriff's Department (OCSD) Update from Chief Vuong

  Received report.

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  24.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  By consensus, the City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars
  as presented in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the
  public record.
